scientific_integrity: The infinite claim follows from spectral decomposition and strict convexity. Finite symbolic and numerical checks provide reproducibility but are not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform per-class prices, connected undirected weighted clique windmills, nonnegative conductances, total-resistance objective only; general unequal edge prices and other objectives unproved. Specialized historical coverage cannot be ruled out; the full text of one windmill resistance article was inaccessible.
title: Universal edge-support threshold in Kirchhoff-index design of clique windmills
